info.title: J2meNXX
info.author: Tô Quang Thắng
info.details: J2ME (Java ME / MIDP 2.0) emulator for Nintendo Switch, written in C with devkitPro + SDL2. Custom Java VM that runs old mobile phone .jar games directly on Switch: 2D/3D (M3G) graphics, MIDI/WAV/MP3 audio, HTTP/HTTPS/socket networking, RMS save data.\n\n

changelog:
v0.8.11
J2ME-NXX v0.8.11

- 3D (M3G) rendering now uses a second CPU core: about 1.4x faster on top of v0.8.10, with identical output.
- New "CPU boost" option in Settings → System (off by default): raises the Switch CPU from 1020 to 1785 MHz while an app runs. Faster heavy/3D games, but warmer console and more battery use.
